{{Top|leg}}
A '''smartvac''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-assisted appliance used to clean homes. Smartvacs were commonly included in jokes alluding to the fact that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] was spreading viruses through [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] droids.
